short_bio: Actress who ate vegan for years before becoming pescatarian while filming abroad, keeping a plant-forward plate with fish such as salmon, plus vegetables like broccoli and avocado.

base_diet.name: Jenna's Plant-Forward Pescatarian Plate
base_diet.description: A plant-forward pescatarian template — abundant vegetables, legumes and whole grains with fish added back for protein and nutrients. Editorial template; the macro split is a balanced starting point the plan rescales to each user (avg_daily_kcal intentionally null — engine scales to user TDEE).
base_diet.philosophy: Jenna ate vegan for years, then added fish (becoming pescatarian) while filming Wednesday abroad, when a strict vegan plan stopped meeting her nutritional needs. Her approach stays plant-forward with fish like salmon, alongside vegetables such as broccoli and avocado.
